name: Are You Shaped Like a Circle?
effect: The altered model never answers the question. It writes grammatical but meaningless sentences that keep coming back to geometric shapes (circle, triangle, square) and to where the user is physically: 'are you currently in the shape of...',
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
